The Create AI Agents Championship is a global competition with prizes worth over Dh2.5 million. 

It was launched on 7 October 2026 by Dubai’s Crown Prince, Sheikh Hamdan.

Participants are encouraged to identify priority problems, design AI-assisted systems to address
them, test the impact of their solutions, and explore turning them into viable, scalable products,
services and projects.

The challenge represents a shift in the competition model: from developing digital applications to developing independent systems based on assistive AI, within real applications designed for real users and real markets.
